title: gateway oscore stores: unreachable Full branch in accept() cache-miss path (dead defensive code)
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz), correctness pass. gateway.rs:537-541 (recipient) and the sender equivalent (~647-650): accept() first calls is_replay -> load(), which either inserts the cache entry or propagates an error, so the else-branch push (and its capacity check) can never execute. Harmless dead defensive code today; delete it or restructure when the eviction policy (project-LICHEN-worker6-2c2k) lands, so the capacity invariant has exactly one enforcement point.
